finding: Frozen relational restoration clauses remain plausible, but they are not isolated from a direct interaction/order-aware composition-risk model.
finding_zh: 冻结关系型恢复子句仍可能成立，但尚未与直接的交互／顺序感知组合风险模型区分。
required_action: Run a fully crossed template-held-out test using the same intervention table, descriptors, capacity, compute, and false-block calibration; compare clause induction with a direct pairwise/higher-order/order-aware risk model and independent execution truth.
required_action_zh: 做完全交叉的模板留出实验，共享同一干预表、描述特征、容量、计算与 false-block 校准；与直接二元／高阶／顺序感知风险模型比较，并用独立执行真值判定。

finding: The surviving thesis is atom-level causal intervention effects for minimal rubric repair; executable/versioned rubric packaging is not itself novel.
finding_zh: 可存活主张是原子级因果干预效应驱动最小 Rubric 修复；可执行／版本化 Rubric 本身不是新颖点。
required_action: Use externally independent causal/neutral labels and preregister causal-vs-association representation × sparse-constrained-vs-generic/greedy updater under identical budgets.
required_action_zh: 要求外部独立的 causal／neutral 标签，并预注册“因果 vs 关联表示 × 稀疏约束 vs 通用／贪心更新器”的交叉实验，预算完全一致。

finding: Canonical compaction is plausible, but the non-local/order-sensitive graph mechanism is not isolated from semantic deduplication plus identical replay/rollback metadata.
finding_zh: 规范化压缩仍可能成立，但非局部／顺序敏感图机制尚未与语义去重 + 相同 replay／rollback 元数据区分。
required_action: Run a matched crossed ablation on non-local/order-sensitive histories against a semantic-deduplication/reconciliation compactor with identical replay probes, rollback metadata, verifier access, and disjoint independent evaluation.
required_action_zh: 在非局部／顺序敏感历史上做匹配交叉消融，与语义去重／协调压缩器比较；共享相同 replay probe、rollback 元数据、verifier 访问，并用互斥独立集评测。

finding: The persistent lesson split is reducible to a frozen support-conditioned gate/router because descendants do not contain materially distinct learned content.
finding_zh: 所谓持久经验分裂可被 support-conditioned gate／router 复现，因为不同 descendant 并没有实质不同的学习内容。
required_action: Retire this version; any child must define genuinely different persistent descendant content and beat matched frozen gate/router, duplicated-identical-content lineage, and non-causal specialization controls.
required_action_zh: 退役当前版本；后续子方向必须定义真正不同的 descendant 持久内容，并优于匹配的冻结 gate／router、复制相同内容的 lineage 和非因果专化控制。

finding: The bounded-probe transfer problem survives, but the learned typed transition representation is not identified against the same typed structure instantiated non-learnedly from schemas, documentation, and probes.
finding_zh: 有界 Probe 迁移问题成立，但学习型类型化转移表示尚未与由 schema／文档／Probe 非学习实例化的同一类型结构区分。
required_action: Add the exact same P/E/X typed representation as a non-learned baseline from identical documentation, schemas, and N probes with matched capacity and end-to-end budget; only cross-source learned parameterization may differ.
required_action_zh: 加入完全相同的 P/E/X 类型化表示作为非学习基线，由相同文档、schema 和 N 个 Probe 实例化，并匹配容量与端到端预算；只允许跨源学习参数化不同。

finding: The immutable authority ceiling is sound, but q risks being evaluation-only triage and the deterministic fixed-ceiling transition-envelope simplification is missing.
finding_zh: 不可提升的权限上限合理，但 q 可能只是评测筛选，且缺少确定性 fixed-ceiling transition-envelope 简化基线。
required_action: Make q's frozen output execution-relevant in the lease state and compare with deterministic fixed-ceiling transition-envelope/lease triage using identical mutation representation, canaries, labels, calls, and reauthorization budget.
required_action_zh: 让 q 的冻结输出真正进入执行相关 lease state，并与确定性的 fixed-ceiling transition-envelope／lease triage 比较；使用相同 mutation 表示、canary、标签、调用和重授权预算。

finding: The nested intervention design is valid, but explicit pathway decomposition is unnecessary unless it beats a direct repair learner with the same structural labels and generator metadata.
finding_zh: 嵌套干预设计有效，但只有在优于拥有相同结构路径标签和生成器元数据的直接 repair learner 时，显式路径分解才必要。
required_action: Give the direct-repair baseline the same structural pathway labels and generator metadata as ordinary features, without explicit pathway estimands; matching held-out repair gain and intervention efficiency falsifies decomposition necessity.
required_action_zh: 把相同结构路径标签和生成器元数据作为普通特征交给直接 repair baseline，但不显式估计 pathway；若留出修复收益和干预效率相当，则路径分解的必要性被否定。

finding: The page conflates a persistent symbolic representation with search-free behavior: exact constraint solving is still recomputed at test time, with no matched typed n-ary factor control sharing the decoder.
finding_zh: 页面把持久符号表示与无搜索持久行为混为一谈：测试时仍会重新做精确约束求解，且缺少共享 decoder 的匹配类型化 n 元 factor 对照。
required_action: Preregister a representation × decoder test: symbolic clauses versus a matched typed n-ary factor model with the identical exact solver, plus a search-free compiled symbolic decoder; match end-to-end inference budgets.
required_action_zh: 预注册“表示 × Decoder”实验：符号子句 vs 匹配的类型化 n 元 factor，两者共享同一精确求解器；再加入符号对象的无搜索编译 decoder，并匹配端到端推理预算。

finding: The Farkas certificate proves no feasible repair lies wholly in the stored-delta span, not that a pure orthogonal repair exists or is the right new knowledge.
finding_zh: Farkas 证书只能证明纯 stored-delta span 内不存在可行修复，不能证明纯正交修复存在或就是正确的新知识。
required_action: Add a mixed span+orthogonal parameterization and an equal-access/equal-budget full-space constrained low-rank adapter solver; retain the projection/new-knowledge claim only if it wins on independent hidden execution truth.
required_action_zh: 加入 span + 正交混合参数化，以及访问与预算相同的全空间受约束低秩 adapter 求解器；只有在独立隐藏执行真值上仍获胜时保留投影／新知识主张。

finding: Deterministic compilation plus learned residual is coherent, but the residual-specific thesis is not isolated from a generic matched local-delta editor.
finding_zh: 确定性编译 + 学习残差是连贯方案，但残差专属主张尚未与通用匹配 local-delta editor 区分。
required_action: Add a generic local-delta editor with identical compiled state, residual supervision, data, capacity, calls, tokens, steps, and wall-clock; keep the structured-residual claim only if it wins on held-out contract transfer.
required_action_zh: 加入通用 local-delta editor，输入相同编译状态、残差监督、数据、容量、调用、token、步数和墙钟；只有在留出 contract 迁移上仍获胜时保留结构化残差主张。

finding: Evaluator drift is real, but the filtered-state mechanism is not separated from a retrained recurrent transition-free predictor seeing the same chronological observations and interventions.
finding_zh: Evaluator 漂移问题真实，但 filtered-state 机制尚未与看到相同时间序列观测和干预的重训练 recurrent transition-free predictor 区分。
required_action: Add a retrained capacity/data/budget-matched recurrent transition-free control with identical chronological observations and intervention supervision; compare frozen future-version extrapolation on independent endpoint truth.
required_action_zh: 加入重训练、容量／数据／预算匹配的 recurrent transition-free 对照，使用相同时间序列观测和干预监督，并在独立终点真值上比较冻结后的未来版本外推。
